about:
Chesapeake Plastics Manufacturing was founded in 2003 by Steven Moore and Mark McGrath in Lusby, Maryland, to provide affordable injection molding services. The company began as a response to the need for accessible, rapid-turnaround plastic part production in the Mid-Atlantic region.

The shop offers design-to-manufacturing capabilities under one roof, including injection molding, rapid prototyping with mold production in less than a week, and production tooling. All work is performed at its Lusby facility, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves the Department of Defense as well as entrepreneurs and crowdfunding campaigns, notably assisting Kickstarter projects from design specifications through prototyping and tooling. It also supports customers across Maryland, Virginia, Delaware, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Washington, D.C., with nationwide reach.

Chesapeake Plastics states its mission is to exceed customer expectations in quality, rapid delivery, and cost through continuous improvement and customer interaction. Its differentiators include in-house rapid prototyping, end-to-end service for crowdfunding entrepreneurs, and a commitment to meeting tight deadlines.
